areas.name: Route and Profile Setup
areas.location_cue: The Steam library, SteamVR runtime, title menu, campaign hub, and profile panels.
areas.note: Chosen route: native Windows PC VR through SteamVR. Quest and PlayStation VR add no separately required content. Online co-op closed on 30 March 2026; all still-achievable work is single-player.

items.label: Use the Windows PC VR release

levels.1: Verify the headset runtime and game edition before creating the completion profile.
levels.2: Install the current Steam build and launch it through SteamVR on the chosen PC route.
levels.3: Update Zombie Army VR in Steam, start SteamVR, connect the intended headset and controllers, and launch the native Windows build. Confirm campaign and Horde are both present before beginning; no secondary platform contains exclusive completion content.

levels.1: Let Steam finish synchronizing before and after long cleanup sessions.
levels.2: Close the game normally and confirm Steam reports that Cloud status is up to date.
levels.3: Return to the hub, quit through the game menu, and wait in Steam until Cloud status says up to date. Do not uninstall, switch PCs, or overwrite a conflict prompt while the newer medals, collectibles, or upgrades exist only locally.

levels.1: Reliable aiming and reloading prevent avoidable failures during score cleanup.
levels.2: Set handedness, height, turning, movement, weapon angle, and a preferred reload style before the campaign.
levels.3: Use the tutorial range to align every weapon class, position body pouches within easy reach, and test automatic, manual, or authentic reloading. Keep one control profile for score attempts so changing angles does not disturb muscle memory.

levels.1: The hub and permanent progression tools open after the handling lesson.
levels.2: Finish every guided prompt and reach the campaign hub.
levels.3: Complete movement, aiming, reloading, equipment, and firing prompts, then continue until the hub loads. Inspect the mission board, workbench, firing range, collectible display, and loadout wall before deploying.

levels.1: The hub separates campaign cleanup from weapons, range records, displays, and Horde.
levels.2: Track campaign clears, medals, Z-Challenges, collectibles, guns, upgrades, range medals, combat records, skins, characters, and Horde maps.
levels.3: Build one checklist from the mission board, collectible displays, weapon wall, workbench, firing-range result cards, character and skin selectors, combat counters, and all four Horde maps. Co-op is unavailable and is not a routine requirement; no New Game Plus or rotating event branch is currently exposed.
